notes: Contraction paired with history-replace-0001: removes the revision's original fact, 'Pompeii was destroyed by an eruption of Mount Vesuvius' (functional relation). Cardinality question: Mount Etna, the revision's new object; it was never said to have destroyed Pompeii, so its 'no' rests on the removed fact. Related near reads the removed fact through the inverse relation (new row eruption_destroyed in the staging file). Related far and the two 2-hop derived questions describe the volcano by what it did to Pompeii and look up facts stored about Vesuvius by name (its city, its region, its last eruption), so after the removal nothing says which volcano they are about. The revision's questions about Etna (island, constant activity) are not reused: they were bridges for the new object.
